text.title: Selma's Summer Trip
body: Selma's family goes to visit their grandparents in Constantine every summer.
Last year, they travelled by train for the first time.
The journey lasted about six hours, and Selma looked out of the window the whole time.
When they arrived, her grandmother was waiting for them at the station with a big smile.
Every evening, Selma's grandfather tells stories about his childhood.
Selma always listens carefully and asks a lot of questions.
Next summer, the family plans to travel by car instead of by train.
Selma is looking forward to seeing the countryside more closely because she loves nature.
She has already started counting the days until the trip.
